audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty rating stands; the phase split was misrepresented by the chart.
audit.why: 53.09% over 2121 games: Olaf owns levels 1-2 outright and Gangplank takes over from 6 into first item. That is the shape the mirror (gangplank__olaf) already settled on.
audit.corrected: Kept FAV / 7.5/10 and restated the lane as early-Olaf, late-Gangplank.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted both the packet and the already-audited mirror in five of seven rows, and its own prose.
audit.why: Mirror set the group as L1 Olaf, L2 Olaf, L3 Skill, L4-5 Skill, L6 Gangplank, First item Gangplank, 2+ Skill — identical to the packet chart. Ratings invert from the mirror's 3/3/5/5/7/7/5.
audit.corrected: Whole chart flipped as one atomic group across both layers: sides to Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill and ratings to 7/7/5/5/3/3/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings gave Olaf's W lifesteal/omnivamp ('W sustain', 'W-sustain', 'W omnivamp').
audit.why: Olaf's W is attack speed plus a SHIELD; the lifesteal and attack speed come from the passive and scale with MISSING health.
audit.corrected: W restated as Tough It Out's shield; sustain and attack speed reassigned to the missing-health passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings claim a 'barrel knock-up'. Powder Keg does not knock up.
audit.why: Riot's Powder Keg text is damage spread plus a SLOW — no displacement anywhere in the kit. The real level-6 flip is Remove Scurvy curing the Undertow slow and healing, on a 22/20/18/16/14s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Knock-up removed from whys[4] and spikes[1]; Remove Scurvy's cure-plus-heal and its cooldown put in its place.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said 'Ragnarok cleanses his W slow-removal mind-game'.
audit.why: Ragnarok grants immunity to disables only while he keeps attacking; it does not cleanse anything of Gangplank's, and Riot's text does not say slows are covered — so no slow-immunity claim is made.
audit.corrected: Restated as disable immunity that holds while you keep swinging, on a 100/90/80s cooldown.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1, Undertow 9s with a full reset on pickup, Reckless Swing 11s at rank 1 — Parrrley is only 4.5s, so his poke is not a window you can wait out.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into whys[4], tradeGood and dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Undertow's slow plus your missing-health attack speed wins first contact — Gangplank has no dash and one barrel armed.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Respect Gangplank's Powder Kegs completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Undertow's slow wins the first trades and Tough It Out shields the answer. Step on him before a second Powder Keg arms — these are the levels you own, so bank them.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Gangplank, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow him off his barrel, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing — Tough It Out shields whatever he answers with.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Gangplank, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow him off his barrel, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing — Tough It Out shields whatever he answers with.

edits.before: Level 6 is his — W cleanses your Q-slow, citrus heals the trade, and the barrel knock-up resets the fight even after you ult in.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Remove Scurvy cures your Undertow slow and heals the trade on a 22s cooldown, resetting a fight you had won.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses his W slow-removal mind-game and his barrel knock-up window — R in, E true damage, and he can't kite you off.
edits.after: Ragnarok keeps you disable-immune while you keep swinging, and no citrus undoes Reckless Swing's true damage — press R for the kill.

edits.before: Use W omnivamp and ramping passive attack speed to win extended trades before barrels detonate
edits.after: Use Tough It Out's shield and your missing-health attack speed to win the extended trade

notes: Level chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers to match the packet and the already-audited mirror (gangplank__olaf). phases[4].side stays 'Gangplank' and phases[4].rating stays 3/10 — the only rows already correct — and win[4] is already 'Gangplank'; the rating row is included so the group reads complete but is a no-op. Powder Keg has no knock-up in Riot's text: two strings claimed one and both are corrected.
